risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds with VIX in crisis territory (335 reading anomalous/data error), flat yield curve signaling recession risk, FOMC event just passed, and earnings 55 days out creating binary event risk for IT sector.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI9 overbought with MACD crossover and three white soldiers create strong short-term momentum confluence, and fear-zone market sentiment offers contrarian entry opportunity near support at 280.49.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price remains below all major moving averages (20/50/200 EMA/SMA), ADX shows no directional strength despite overbought extremes, macro environment is severely unfavourable with VIX crisis and flat yield curve, and earnings binary event in 55 days with zero fundamental catalysts or insider conviction.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum (RSI9 overbought, MACD crossover, three white soldiers) offers tactical confluence at support, and fear-zone sentiment presents contrarian opportunity.
